title: TaleCraft SMP
description: 1.21.1 Modded Neoforge server that contains Create, Create Aeronautics, Create addons AND Farmer's Delight. It also contains datapacks to make your experience fun. Your adventure is your own tale.
body:
Welcome to TaleCraft SMP. This is a 1.21.1 Modded NeoForge server. We have Create, Create addons, Create Aeronautics, Farmer's Delight and the wonderful Vanilla Backport. 

We are excited to have you join our server, as we are always looking for members to play!

## Why should you join?
TaleCraft SMP allows you to have as much fun as you want. We have lots of mods that make the server much more fun to play. This server also lets your creativity and imagination run wild. So you can build, create, or go on adventures like never before. The mods used will make building and creating things much more fun to do. We also have Simple Voice Chat, allowing you to communicate using your voice, which'll make communicating so much easier. It also allows you to use proximity-based communications.

## What are the rules for the server?
- Be respectful towards other players.
- Do not grief unless warranted/consented by the player.
- No X-Ray, exploits or cheats. If you are caught doing any of these, you will be banned.
- Do not build ugly structures, such as a 1-block wide tower.
- Do not build fallic structures whatsoever. This is a 13+ server, meaning there will be children on the server.
- If you are under the age of 16, please keep your mic muted, for safety reasons.
- Have fun.

If any of this interests you, please do join!

And remember, your adventure is your tale! Start your own tale today!

You will need to join the Discord server to get whitelisted.
